vars.prTitle: GroupRepresentation: don't allocate subGroups on read
vars.prBody: getSubGroups() lazily created an empty list, so every serialized group (including brief listings) came out with "subGroups": [] even when subGroupCount > 0, which makes clients think the group has no children. The getter now returns null when subgroups were not populated, and merge() handles groups without populated children.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "GroupRepresentation.getSubGroups() used to lazily allocate a mutable ArrayList and callers append to it. GroupUtils.populateGroupHierarchyFromSubGroups (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/utils/GroupUtils.java:57) builds parent representations with toRepresentation(...) (which never sets subGroups) and then does parent.getSubGroups().add(currGroup) unconditionally (the null check on line 52 only guards the duplicate lookup). With the change getSubGroups() returns null there, so GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups?search=... (populateHierarchy defaults to true) throws a NullPointerException (500) as soon as a matching group is not top-level.", "severity": "High"}]
